subject: literacy
concept: Evaluating a critical interpretation or scholarly claim about a literary work against the text itself
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the Truth Seeking Pillar — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a critical claim about a text to the textual evidence that supports or complicates it
exercise.abstract: Student evaluates whether a given critical interpretation of a text is well-supported by the text itself

misconception_flags: accepts a stated critical interpretation as automatically correct without checking it against the actual text

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
